chunks: 2 – Al-Ḥusayn ibn al-Qāsim ibn Muḥammad ibn Ayyūb ibn Shammūn

He is thiqa (reliable) in my view. However, there is discussion regarding those who narrate from him. And his father, al-Qāsim, was among the notable figures of the Shīʿa, however nothing has been narrated from him.

key_terms.وجوه الشيعة: Wujuh al-Shiʿa (notable/prominent figures of the Shia)

ai.seo_question: Who is al-Husayn ibn al-Qasim and what is his status in Shia hadith sciences?
ai.summary: This entry from the book of al-Duʿafāʾ (The Weak) discusses al-Ḥusayn ibn al-Qāsim. While the general consensus weakens him, the author considers him reliable (thiqa), though there is some scrutiny regarding his narrators. It also notes that his father was a prominent Shia figure despite narrating little.

en.tashayyu: 2 – al-Ḥusayn b. al-Qāsim b. Muḥammad b. Ayyūb b. Shammūn.

They have weakened him, but according to me he is thiqa.  However there is discussion in regards to those who narrate from him.  And his father, al-Qāsim, was from the noteworthy of the Shīʿa, however nothing has been narrated from him.
